quiz: Each added geohash character splits the cell into a smaller box. What does sharing more characters mean?
Cell borders are arbitrary lines. Think about a driver standing just over the edge of your cell.
Location pings are tiny, short-lived and get resent every few seconds. Does each one need full disk durability?
Dijkstra spreads out evenly in all directions. Think about what an estimate of the remaining distance changes.
The speed comes from slow work done once before any query. What does that preprocessing add to the graph, and how does it shrink each search?
Reading status and then writing it leaves a gap. What operation lets exactly one request win?
Users close tabs and apps crash. How does the seat come back if no release message is ever sent?
Networks lose responses and clients retry. How does the server recognise the same intent the second time?
A ledger is append-only for audit. How do you cancel a past effect without changing history?
A timeout tells you nothing about whether the other side acted. Guessing either way has a real cost.
Without a cache, a short prefix would need a scan of a huge subtree. What does storing results at each node save?
Clicks arrive late and out of order. Which timestamp gives correct counts, and what decides when to stop waiting?
On replay the same window is written again. Which write gives the same result no matter how often it runs?
Remember that a Bloom filter can wrongly say it has seen an id. What does that cost when every click is money?

Treat the outcome as unknown, keep the payment pending, resolve with the same idempotency key, a status query, webhooks or reconciliation.
